arguments.command:
cd $PWD; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/thread.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("		input?: EntryId,\n","		input: EntryId,\n")
s=s.replace("""		const usedTools =
			input === undefined ? false : await this.ranTools(input, answer);""","""		const usedTools = await this.ranTools(input, answer);""")
s=s.replace("model stopped (`length`: it ran out of output tokens). With the run's `input` entry, `usedTools` tells\n	 * whether the run executed any tool between the input and the answer.","model stopped (`length`: it ran out of output tokens), and whether the run executed any tool between its\n	 * `input` entry and the answer.")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run fix >/dev/null 2>&1; npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -3; npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -E "warnings|format"; git diff --stat
